sql.value: select aof.id, ao.id as opus_id, ao.name_cn, ao.name_original, ao.cover_url, aof.from_user_id, su.nickname as from_user_nickname, aof.create_time from ani_user_feed aof left join ani_opus ao on aof.opus_id = ao.id left join sys_user su on aof.from_user_id = su.id where aof.to_user_id = :toUserId and aof.is_deleted = 0 and ao.is_deleted = 0 #[and ao.name_cn like :nameCn] #[and ao.name_original like :nameOriginal] order by aof.id desc

select aof.id, ao.id as opus_id, ao.name_cn, ao.name_original, ao.cover_url, aof.to_user_id as from_user_id, su.nickname as from_user_nickname, aof.create_time from ani_user_feed aof left join ani_opus ao on aof.opus_id = ao.id left join sys_user su on aof.to_user_id = su.id where aof.from_user_id = :fromUserId and aof.is_deleted = 0 and ao.is_deleted = 0 #[and ao.name_cn like :nameCn] #[and ao.name_original like :nameOriginal] order by aof.id desc
